rules: peer-set stagger 125 ms (six headers, six underlines)

phases.reveal: six headers spring-pop in 125 ms apart from 0.3s (scale 1.14→1, blur 10→0, power3.out, 0.3s each); glow breathing from frame 0

phases.marks: six red underlines under the channel names, 125 ms apart from 2.0s, 0.38s each, tilted with their cards
handwriting '10+ clients · every niche · all ranking' from 4.6s (on '10 plus other clients')

phases.camera: slow push 1.015→1.08 sine.inOut about (960,520); peak ≈27 px/s at the layout edge mid-push

exit.vector: push-in settling at 1.08 about (960,520), sine.inOut → ≈0 px/s at the last frame; glow still breathing (≈4 px/s drift). No exit tween (hard cut).

entry.vector: camera at 1.00, push starts from zero velocity; glow breathing/drifting ≈7 px/s from frame 0; first header lands at 0.3s
